title: Validate a Requirements File
prompt: Write parse_requirements(text) returning a dict of package -> version from a requirements-style string. Ignore blank lines and comments (# ...). Raise ValueError on any line without a version pin.

tests.name: parses and validates
tests.hint: for line in text.splitlines(): strip, skip blanks and "#"; if "==" not in line: raise ValueError; name, ver = line.split("==")
